name: Großefehn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Großefehn (three acorns above a windmill on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Großefehn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Großefehn arms — acorns and windmill on yellow
